# Executor

A person appointed to administer an estate. Includes professional executors, administrators (intestacy), and administrators with will annexed

Source: [`v3/executor.json`](../../v3/executor.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/executor.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier for this executor appointment within the INHERIT document |
| `personId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the Person.id of the appointed executor or administrator |
| `personIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced person |
| `role` | one of `primary`, `secondary`, `substitute`, `administrator`, `administrator_with_will_annexed`, `literary`, `digital`, `specialist` | yes | The executor's role in the estate administration |
| `isProfessional` | `boolean` | | Whether this executor is a professional (solicitor, accountant, trust corporation). Professional executors typically charge fees |
| `firmName` | `string` | | Name of the professional firm, if the executor is acting in a professional capacity |
| `grantType` | one of `grant_of_probate`, `letters_of_administration`, `letters_of_administration_with_will_annexed`, `succession_certificate`, `certificate_of_inheritance`, `court_appointment`, `resealing`, `european_certificate_of_succession` | | The type of grant issued by the court authorising this person to act. Includes territory-neutral alternatives for non-Commonwealth jurisdictions |
| `grantDate` | `string` (date) | | Date the grant was issued |
| `grantReference` | `string` | | Court reference number for the grant |
| `issuingCourt` | `string` | | Name of the court or registry that issued the grant |
| `notes` | `string` | | Free-text notes about this executor appointment — reservations, renunciations, or special circumstances |
| `organisationId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the Organisation.id if the executor is a trust corporation or professional firm acting as executor. Mutually exclusive with personId |
| `organisationIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced organisation |
| `primary` | `boolean` | | Whether this is the primary (lead) executor. Only one executor per estate should be marked as primary |
| `consultWith` | array of `string` (uuid) | | Person IDs of individuals the executor should consult before making significant decisions. Models co-equal authority and consultation requirements |
| `scope` | `object` | | The scope of this executor's authority, for specialist executors. If absent, the executor has authority over the entire estate |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](common/provenance.md) | | Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it |
| `conflictsOfInterest` | array of `object` | | Declared conflicts of interest — executor/trustee who is also a beneficiary, drafter, or family member |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.
